ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings - amended to allow for provision of additional information from A&R Whitcoulls, and analysis of information gathered during market inquiries.
ACCC requested further information from A&R Whitcoulls. ACCC timeline suspended.
ACCC received further information from A&R Whitcoulls. ACCC timeline recommenced.
Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings, amended to allow for analysis of additional information provided by A&R Whitcoulls.
